text:
A boy asked his Bitcoin-investing dad...
...for $10.00 worth of Bitcoin currency.
Dad: $9.67? What do you need $10.32 for?
gist: A bitcoin-investing father misquotes his son's small request with constantly changing amounts, showing the currency's wild volatility.

text: I saw my wife, slightly drunk, yelling at the TV: “Don’t go in there! Don’t go in the church, you moron!” She is watching our wedding video again.
gist: A tipsy wife yells at a horror-movie victim not to go into the church, and it turns out she is watching their own wedding video.

text:
A man takes his seat at the World Cup final. He looks over and notices there's an extra seat in between himself and the next guy.
The man says, "Who would ever miss the World Cup final?”
The guy replies, "Well that was my wife’s seat. We have been to the last five World Cup finals together, but sadly she passed away.”
The man says back, "That’s terrible, but couldn’t you get another close family member to come with you?”
The guy says, "No.  They're all at the funeral."
gist: Fan explains his empty seat at the World Cup final belonged to his late wife, and no relative could come because they are all at her funeral.

text:
"Mom, I'm dating a man."
"Whom, sweetheart?"
"Mike the mailman."
"Mike the mailman? But he could be your father!"
"But mom, age is just a number."
"Sweetheart, I don't think you understood."
gist: Daughter defends dating the much older mailman with 'age is just a number', but mother's 'he could be your father' is meant literally.

text: My wife accused me of hating her family and relatives... I replied, "No, I don't hate your relatives. In fact, I like your mother-in-law a lot better than I like mine."
gist: Husband denies hating his wife's family by saying he likes her mother-in-law more than his own, which secretly means his mother over hers.

text:
Son: "Mom, Dad, I'm gay."
Mom: *Stares at Dad*
Dad: *Clenches fist*
Mom: "Don't!"
Dad: *Sweats Profusely*
Mom: "..."
Dad: "HI GAY, I'M DAD"
gist: Son comes out as gay, the mother tensely forbids the father, and he can't resist the dad joke 'Hi Gay, I'm Dad'.

text:
My boss: “You’re fired.”
Me: *turns in gun and badge*
My boss: “You’re a waiter where did you get those”
gist: Fired employee dramatically surrenders a gun and badge like a movie cop, but he is just a waiter.

text:
I got fired from my job because I kept asking my customers whether they would prefer “Smoking” or “Non-smoking”.
Apparently the correct terms are “Cremation” and “Burial”.
gist: A funeral home worker is fired for asking clients 'smoking or non-smoking' instead of cremation or burial.

text:
Me: What's the wifi password?
Bartender: You need to buy a drink first.
Me: Okay, I'll have a coke.
Bartender: Is Pepsi okay?
Me: Sure. How much is that?
Bartender: $3.
Me: There you go. So what's the wifi password?
Bartender: You need to buy a drink first. No spaces, all lowercase.
gist: A bartender's repeated answer 'You need to buy a drink first' turns out to be the literal wifi password.

text:
“Son In Iraq I killed 15 people.”
Son: Dad you were a helicopter mechanic
Dad:Never said I was a good one
gist: A veteran boasts of killing 15 people in the war, and when reminded he was a helicopter mechanic he admits he was a bad one.

text:
I was sitting on a bus with a friend and he told me this joke...
What do you do if you see an Epileptic having a fit in the bath?
Throw in your laundry.
The guy behind us leaned over and said "I think that's disgusting. My son died in the bath whilst having a fit."
We both went white and apologised. The guy got up to get off and said, "he choked on a sock."
gist: A stranger shames two men for a joke about an epileptic in the bath, then reveals his son died there choking on a sock, confirming the joke.

text:
While picking up a turkey for this Thanksgiving, I overheard this gem.
A lady was picking through the frozen turkeys, but she couldn't find one big enough for her family.
She asked a stock boy, "Do these turkeys get any bigger?"
The stock boy replied, "No ma'am, they’re dead."
gist: A shopper asks if the frozen turkeys get any bigger, and the clerk literally answers that they cannot grow because they are dead.

text:
I called my wife at work and asked, "Do you ever get a shooting pain across your body, like someone's got a voodoo doll of you and they're stabbing it?" Sounding concerned, she said, "No."
I responded, "How about now?"
gist: A husband calls his wife asking about voodoo-doll stabbing pains, and when she says no he asks 'how about now?', revealing he has the doll.

text:
I used to sell security alarms door to door, and I was really good at it.
If no one was home,  I would just leave a brochure on the kitchen table.
gist: A door-to-door alarm salesman brags he was great at it because when nobody was home he left a brochure on the kitchen table, revealing he broke in.

text:
The son went to his dad and asked him, "Dad, what's an alcoholic?"
So the dad replied, "Do you see those four trees? Well, an alcoholic would see eight."
The son replied, "But Dad, I only see two."
gist: A father explains an alcoholic sees double by pointing at four trees, and his son replies there are only two, revealing the father is drunk.

text:
Wife: “I’m pregnant.”
Me: “Hi Pregnant, I’m Dad.”
Wife: “No you’re not.”
gist: A husband answers his wife's pregnancy news with the dad-joke greeting Hi Pregnant, I'm Dad, and she replies that he is not, implying he isn't the father.

text:
I was going to donate blood today, but they always ask waaaay too many personal questions
Like, "who's blood is this", and "where did you get it?"
gist: Would-be blood donor complains the clinic asks too many personal questions, and the questions reveal he is bringing someone else's blood, implying murder.

text:
I finally realized my parents favored my twin brother.
It hit me when they asked me to blow up balloons for his surprise birthday party.
gist: Man realizes his parents favor his twin brother when they ask him to blow up balloons for the twin's surprise birthday party, which is also his own birthday.

text:
A guy sits down in a diner and asks for a bowl of hot chili...
The waitress says, "Sorry, but the guy next to you got the last bowl".
He looks over and sees that the guy's finished his meal, but the bowl of chili is still full. He asks, "Are you going to eat that chili?"
The other guy says, "No. Help yourself".
He slides the bowl of chili over and starts to eat. When he gets about half way down, his spoon hits something. He looks down sees a dead mouse and immediately pukes all the chili back into the bowl.
The other guy says, "Yeah, that's about as far as I got, too".
gist: A diner eats a stranger's untouched chili, finds a dead mouse halfway and vomits back into the bowl, and the stranger says that's as far as he got too.

text:
My wife left me because I am insecure
No wait, she's back. She just went to get coffee
gist: Man says his wife left him because he is insecure, then corrects with relief that she only went for coffee, proving his insecurity.

text:
If a tree falls in the forest and no one is around to hear it...
...then my illegal logging business is a success.
gist: Starts the philosophical riddle about a tree falling unheard in the forest and concludes that it means the speaker's illegal logging business is succeeding.

text:
How do you break up two blind guys fighting?
Yell, "My money's on the guy with the knife!"
gist: To break up two blind men fighting, you shout that you're betting on the one with the knife, so both freeze in fear.

text:
Husband: I have cheated once
Wife: me too.
husband: 1st of Apriii....
Wife: 18th of June
gist: Husband confesses to cheating, wife admits she did too; he tries to pass his off as an April Fools' prank, and she answers with the real date of her affair.

text:
I was applying for Australian citizenship and the interviewer asked, “Do you have a criminal record?”
I said, “No. Is that still required?”
gist: Asked at an Australian citizenship interview if he has a criminal record, the applicant asks whether that is still required, joking about Australia's convict-colony origins.

text:
My attractive female neighbor is completely paranoid.
She thinks I'm following or even stalking her, she is worried that I may be obsessed with her and any time she hears a noise in her house she is...purified? Oh, wait: petrified. Sorry, it's not easy reading a diary through binoculars from a tree.
gist: Man calls his attractive neighbor paranoid for thinking he stalks her, then stumbles over a word and reveals he is reading her diary through binoculars from a tree.

text:
My girlfriend yelled at me today saying, "You weren't even listening just now, were you?!"
I thought, "Man, what a weird way to start a conversation."
gist: Girlfriend accuses the man of not listening, and his inner reaction treats her accusation as an odd conversation opener, proving he indeed wasn't listening.

text:
The guy sat next to me on the train pulled out a photo of his wife and said, “She’s beautiful, isn’t she?” I said, “If you think she’s beautiful, you should see my girlfriend mate.”
He said, “Why? Is she a stunner?” I said, “No, she’s an optician.”
gist: Stranger on a train boasts his wife is beautiful; the man says he should go see his girlfriend, who turns out to be an optician, implying the stranger needs his eyes checked.

text:
Sex with the priest's wife
Jack goes to his buddy Bob and says ...
"I'm sleeping with the priest's wife. Can you hold him in church for an hour after mass for me?"
The friend doesn't like it but being a buddy, he agrees.
After mass, Bob starts talking to the priest, asking him all sorts of stupid questions, just to keep him occupied.
Finally the priest gets annoyed and asks him what he's really up to.
Bob feeling guilty, finally confesses to the priest...
"My friend is sleeping with your wife right now, so he asked me to keep you occupied."
The priest smiles, puts a brotherly hand on Bob's shoulder and says...
"You better hurry home now. My wife died a year ago".
gist: Man stalls a priest so his friend can sleep with the priest's wife, confesses, and learns the priest is a widower, so the friend is with the confessor's own wife.

text:
Today I donated my watch, phone, and $500 to a poor guy.
You can’t imagine the happiness I felt as I saw him put his pistol back in his pocket.
gist: Man describes generously giving his valuables to a poor stranger and his joy at the end, which reveals he was being robbed at gunpoint.

text:
Genie: You have 3 wishes.
Me: I've seen this before. Whatever I wish for will come back and bite me in some way.
Genie: I promise that won't happen. I'm so sure it won't I'll give you infinite wishes if it does.
Me: Okay. I wish for a boomerang with teeth.
Genie: You son of a ........
gist: Genie promises infinite wishes if a wish backfires, and the man traps him by wishing for a toothed boomerang that bites by design.

text:
Do you ever wake up, kiss the person sleeping beside you, and be glad that you are alive?
I did and apparently will not be allowed on this airline again...
gist: Heartwarming routine of kissing the person sleeping beside you turns out to be done to a stranger on a plane, getting him banned.

text:
When I was a kid, my parents would always say "Excuse my french" after a swear word...
...I'll never forget that first day at school when the teacher asked did we know any french.
gist: Parents always apologize for swearing as 'French', so when the teacher asks the class if anyone knows French, the child proudly recites curse words.

text:
My wife is pregnant and my doctor asked me if I had ever been present at a childbirth before.
I replied, "Yes just once."
The doctor asked, "What was it like?"
I said, "It was dark, then suddenly very bright."
gist: An expectant father says he was present at one childbirth before, and his description of darkness then sudden light reveals it was his own birth.

text:
A guy walks into a bar and asks for a beer
"That'll be five dollars", says the bartender, and the guy throws 20 quarters onto the floor. Reluctantly, the bartender picks up the coins and serves the beer.
The next day, the guy comes into the bar, asks for a beer, throws 20 quarters onto the floor, etc.
The next day, again.
On the fourth day, he asks for a beer, and hands the bartender a 10$ bill. The bartender takes advantage of his chance for revenge, throws 20 quarters onto the floor and yells "here's your change asshole!"
The guy looks down at the coins and says: "I'll have another beer, please."
gist: A customer pays for beer by throwing coins on the floor each day; when the bartender takes revenge by throwing his change down, the man just uses it to order another beer.

text: My daughter screeched, "Daaaaaad, you haven't listened to one word I've said, have you!?" What a strange way to start a conversation with me...
gist: A daughter angrily accuses her dad of not listening to a word she said, and he calls it a strange way to start a conversation, proving her point.

text:
Doctor: (handing me my new born baby) I'm sorry but your wife didn't make it
Me: (handing baby back to him) Bring me the one my wife made
gist: A doctor hands a man his newborn saying his wife didn't make it, and the man hands the baby back asking for the one his wife did make.

text:
Her: What do you do?
Me: I race cars.
Her: Do you win many races?
Me: No, the cars are much faster.
gist: A man says he races cars, and when asked if he wins, says no because the cars are faster, meaning he literally runs against them.

text:
A man was arrested and taken to an interrogation room
He says to the police officer, "I'm not saying a word without my lawyer present."
"You are the lawyer," says the policeman.
"Exactly, so where's my present?"
gist: An arrested man refuses to talk without his lawyer present, turns out to be the lawyer himself, and asks where his present is.

text:
What does gay mean?
asked a son to his father.
"It means 'happy,'" the father answered.
"Oh," replied the son, "so are you gay, then?"
"No, son, I have a wife."
gist: A father tells his son gay means happy, and when asked if he is gay, says no because he has a wife.

text:
A man wakes up after a heavy night of drinking to his wife happily cooking breakfast.
Confused, he approaches his daughter for an explanation of last night when he arrived home.
"You kicked in the door when you couldn't get your key in the lock, fell through the table and broke it, and pissed your pants."
"Jesus! So then why the hell is she in such a good mood?"
"When she tried to take your pants off to wash them, you slapped her hand away and said, 'Get your hands off me! I'm married!'"
gist: A drunk husband who wrecked the house learns his wife is happy because he pushed her away saying he was married.

text:
An Englishman and an Irishman go to a bakery. The Englishman steals three buns and puts them into his pockets and leaves. He says to the Irishman: “That took great skill and guile to steal those buns. The owner didn’t even see me.”
“That’s just simple thievery,” the Irishman replied. “I’ll show you how to do it the honest way and get the same results.”
The Irishman then proceeded to call out the owner of the bakery and says: “Sir, I want to show you a magic trick.” The owner was intrigued so he came over to see the magic trick.
The Irishman asked him for a bun and then he proceeded to eat it. He asked two more times and after eating them again the owner says: “Okay my friend, where’s the magic trick?”
The Irishman then said: “Look in the Englishman’s pockets.”
gist: After one man shoplifts buns, the other 'honestly' eats three buns as a magic trick and tells the baker to look in the thief's pockets.

text:
A man is walking through a graveyard when he sees another man squatting next to a grave. "Morning!" he calls out.
"No, just having a shit!"
gist: A man greets someone squatting by a grave with 'Morning!', and the other, hearing 'mourning', says no, he is just relieving himself.

text:
Got home to find my wife had left a note on the fridge that said "This isn't working I'm going to my mum's"
I opened up the fridge. The light was on and the beer was cold. I'm not sure what she was talking about.
gist: A wife leaves a fridge note saying 'this isn't working', and the husband opens the fridge, finds it cold and lit, and is puzzled.

text: My wife screamed in pain during labor so I asked, “What’s wrong?”. She screamed. “These contractions are going to kill me!!” “I am sorry, honey,” I replied. “What is wrong?”
gist: A wife in labor screams that the contractions are killing her, and the husband 'helps' by expanding 'what's' into 'what is'.

text:
A drunk guy is showing friends his new apartment...
The last stop is the bedroom, where a big brass gong sits next to the bed.
"What's that gong for?" the friend asks him.
"It's not a gong," the drunk replies. "It's a talking clock."
"How does it work?"
The guys picks up a hammer, gives the gong an ear-shattering pound, and steps back.
Suddenly, someone on the other side of the wall screams, "For God's sake, you asshole...it's 3:30 in the god damn morning!"
gist: A drunk shows off a gong as his talking clock, strikes it at night, and an angry neighbor yells the exact time through the wall.

text:
We are 11 days into self-isolation ands it is really upsetting me to witness my wife standing at the living room window gazing aimlessly into space with tears running down her cheeks.
Don’t get me wrong, I empathize with her.  I’ve considered letting her in many times, but rules are rules.
gist: A husband describes his wife tearfully staring through the window during lockdown, then reveals she is outside and he won't let her in.

text:
The kids asked what was for dinner and I told them "Scraps". They started crying. Spoiled brats, it's really hard to get food at the moment thanks to the panic buying.
And it was a stupid name for a dog anyway.
(Obligatory thank-you edit for the silver!)
(Narwhal! Narwhals are cool!)
gist: A parent says dinner is 'Scraps' amid panic-buying shortages and the kids cry, then it turns out Scraps was the family dog.

text:
Boy aged 4: Dad, I’ve decided to get married.
Dad: Wonderful; do you have a girl in mind?!
Boy: Yes... grandma! She said she loves me, I love her, too....and she’s the best cook & story teller in the whole world!
Dad: That’s nice, but we have  a small problem there!
Boy: What problem?!
Dad: She happens to be my mother. How can you marry my mother!
Boy: Why not?! You married mine!
gist: A small boy wants to marry his grandma, and when his father objects she is his mother, the boy points out the father married the boy's mother.

text:
My wife stormed into the pub last night as me and the boys were downing shots of Tequila.
“You’re coming home now!” she screamed.
“No, I’m not,” I laughed.
She said, “I’m talking to the kids.”
gist: A wife storms into a pub demanding 'you're coming home', the man refuses, and she clarifies she meant the kids drinking with him.

text:
My wife asked me how she compared to past girlfriends...
So I told her she was the only one I had been with!
The others were all eights and nines.
gist: Asked how his wife compares to exes, a man says she was the only 'one', meaning she rated a one out of ten while the others were eights and nines.

text:
Two young boys walked into a pharmacy, picked out a box of tampons, and proceeded to the checkout counter
The man at the counter asked the older boy, "Son, how old are you?"
"Eight" the boy replied.
The man continued, "Do you know what these are used for?"
The boy replied, "Not exactly, but they aren't for me. They're for him... He's my brother. He's four. We saw on TV that if you use these, you will be able to swim and ride a bike. Right now, he can't do either"
gist: A young boy buys tampons for his little brother because a TV ad promised they let you swim and ride a bike.

text:
My ex just sneezed and I accidentally said "bless you"
Now she just staring at the bushes confused wondering who said that.
gist: A man says 'bless you' when his ex sneezes, revealing he is secretly hiding in the bushes near her.

text:
I thought my son was spending too much time playing computer games, so I stopped him and said, "Son, when Abe Lincoln was your age, he was studying books by the light of the fireplace."
He considered that for a moment before replying, "Yeah, well, when Abe Lincoln was your age, he was The President of the United States."
gist: A father shames his gaming son with Lincoln studying by firelight at his age, and the son retorts that at the father's age Lincoln was already president.

text:
My 7 year old nephew showed me with pride the "telephone" he had just made from a string and two tin cans...
I pulled out my iPhone and said, "That's nice, but look at what kids your age make in China!"
gist: An uncle answers his nephew's homemade tin-can phone by showing a smartphone made by children his age in Chinese factories.

text:
A wife got so mad at her husband she packed his bags and told him to get out.
As he walked to the door she yelled, "I hope you die a long, slow, painful death."
He turned around and said, "So, you want me to stay?"
gist: An angry wife throws her husband out wishing him a long, slow, painful death, and he asks whether that means she wants him to stay.

text:
Two men are drinking in a bar
They pull out the sandwiches their wives had lovingly prepared and tuck in.
The bartender comes over and says "you can't eat your own food in here"
So they swapped sandwiches.
gist: Two men eating homemade sandwiches in a bar are told they cannot eat their own food, so they swap sandwiches.

text:
After 3 years, the wife starts to think...
...that their child looks different, so she decides to do a DNA test.
She finds out that the child is actually from completely different parents.
Wife: Honey, I have something very serious to tell you
Husband: What’s up?
Wife: According to DNA test results, this is not our child.
Husband: Well don’t you remember? When we were leaving the hospital, we noticed that our baby had a wet diaper and you said, “Honey, go change the baby, I’ll wait for you here.”
gist: Wife learns from a DNA test that their child isn't theirs, and the husband reveals he swapped babies at the hospital rather than change a wet diaper.

text:
My son came home as I was taking his door off it’s hinges and asked “Dad what are you doing?”
“We’ve updated our privacy policy”
gist: Father removes his son's bedroom door and explains it in the language of a tech company privacy policy update.

text:
My roommate says our house is haunted
I've been living here for 300 years and i havnt noticed shit.
gist: Housemate dismisses claims that the house is haunted, revealing he has lived there 300 years and is himself the ghost.

text:
A 7-year-old is sitting on a park bench eating a chocolate bar.
The man sitting next to him looks over and says, "Eating that many chocolate bars is bad for you."
The boy looks over and responds, "My great grandfather lived to be one hundred and five".
The man replies, "And he ate that much chocolate?"
"No" says the boy, "But he minded his own fucking business."
gist: Stranger lectures a boy about eating chocolate; the boy cites his long-lived great-grandfather, whose secret was minding his own business.

text:
Man says to his boss, "Can we talk? I have a problem."
Boss: "Problem? No such thing, we call it an opportunity!"
Man: "Ok, I have a serious drinking opportunity."
gist: Boss insists problems be called opportunities, so the employee confesses a 'drinking opportunity'.

text:
The penguin joke (my favorite joke)
One day a Cop pulls a van over and when he walks up to the window he sees ten penguins in the back.
The cop asks the man "are those your penguins?"
The man Says "yes, they are my pets."
The cop replies to the man "You need to take them to the zoo right now."
So the man agrees and drives off. The next day the cop pulls over the same van and he walks up to the window and sees the ten pengins all wearing sunglasses.
The cop says to the man "I thought i told you to take those penguins to the zoo."
The man says "I did, today we are going to the beach!"
gist: Cop orders a man with penguins in his van to take them to the zoo; next day the man explains they went to the zoo and are now going to the beach.

text:
A blonde is overweight, so her doctor puts her on a diet.
“I want you to eat regularly for two days, then skip a day, and repeat the procedure for two weeks. The next time I see you, you’ll have lost at least five pounds.”
When the blonde returns, she’s lost nearly 20 pounds.
“Wow, that’s amazing!” the doctor says.
“Did you follow my instructions?”
The blonde nods…
“I’ll tell you, I'd thought I was going to drop dead that third day."
“From hunger, you mean?” said the doctor.
“No, from skipping,” replied the blonde.
gist: Doctor tells a blonde to skip eating every third day, and she nearly dies from skipping (hopping) all day.

text:
My girlfriend's dog died, so to cheer her up I got her an identical one.
She was livid, "what am I going to do with two dead dogs?"
gist: Man replaces his girlfriend's dead dog with an identical one, but the replacement is also dead.

text:
Boy: What's a palindrome?
Teacher: racecar
{10 years later}
Boy: [bursting out of bank in ski mask] where's the palindrome
Getaway driver: [sitting in kayak]
gist: Boy learns 'racecar' as an example of a palindrome, and years later as a bank robber asks for 'the palindrome' getaway vehicle and gets a kayak.

text:
A blind man visits Texas. When he gets to his hotel room, he feels the bed. “Wow, this bed is big!”
“Everything is bigger in Texas,” says the bellhop.
The man heads downstairs to the bar, settles into a huge barstool and orders a beer. A mug is placed between his hands. “Wow these drinks are big!”
The bartender replies, “Everything is big in Texas.”
After downing a few, the blind man asks where the bathroom is. “Second door to the right,” says the bartender.
The blind man heads for the bathroom but accidentally enters the third door, which leads to the swimming pool, and he falls in. Popping his head up from under the water and flailing his arms, he shouts, “Don’t flush, don’t flush!”
gist: A blind man in Texas is told everything is bigger there, so when he falls into the pool instead of the toilet he panics that it is a giant toilet about to be flushed.

text:
Father: “Son, you were adopted.”
Son: “What?! I knew it! I want to meet my biological parents!"
Father: “We are your biological parents. Now pack up, the new ones will pick you up in 20 minutes.”
gist: A son told he is adopted wants his real parents, and the father reveals they are his biological parents and are giving him up now.

text:
A boy scout says to his scout leader, "Sir, is this snake poisonous?" The scout leader says, "No, that snake's not poisonous at all." So the boy picks up the snake, which bites him and the boy starts to spasm and foam at the mouth as the other kids look on in horror...
The scout leader says, "But that snake is venomous. Poison is ingested or absorbed, while venom is injected. Let's get it right next time, boys."
gist: A scout leader says a snake is not poisonous, the boy is bitten and convulses, and the leader pedantically explains the snake is venomous, not poisonous.

text:
Today one of my friends told me I often make people uncomfortable by violating their personal space.
It was an incredibly hurtful thing to say and it completely ruined our bath.
gist: Man is hurt when a friend says he invades personal space, and the reveal is they are sharing a bath.

text:
I called work this morning and whispered, "Sorry boss, I can't come in today. I have a wee cough." He exclaimed, "You have a wee cough!?"
I said, "Really?! Thanks boss, see you next week!"
gist: Worker calls in sick with a wee cough, the boss repeats it, and he hears it as a week off.

text:
I rode the elevator to the eleventh floor, and as I got out, the operator said "Have a good day, son"
"Don't call me son," I said. "You're not my dad."
He scratched his head. "No, but I brought you up, didn't I?"
gist: Elevator operator calls a passenger son and defends it by saying he brought him up, meaning carried him upstairs.

text:
A guy walks into a bar
A guy walks into a crowded local bar, holding a pistol in his hand and yelling, “I have a 45 caliber pistol here with seven rounds in the barrel plus one in the chamber and I want to know who’s been sleeping with my wife.”
A voice from the other end of the bar called out, “You’ll need more ammo”
gist: Armed husband demands to know who slept with his wife, and a voice in the bar says he will need more ammo, implying many men did.

text:
I told my boss that three companies were after me and I need a raise....
My boss asked “what companies? “
Gas, water and electricity.
gist: Employee asks for a raise because three companies are 'after him', which turn out to be the utility companies chasing unpaid bills.

text:
My wife packed my bags and kicked me out of the house.
As I walked out the front door, she screamed,
"I wish you a slow and painful death, you bastard!"
"Oh," I replied, "so now you want me to stay!"
gist: Wife kicks her husband out wishing him a slow painful death, and he concludes she now wants him to stay, since living with her is that death.

text:
A 90-year-old man goes for a physical and all of his tests come back normal. The doctor says, “Larry, everything looks great. How are you doing mentally and emotionally? Are you at peace with God?”
Larry replies, “God and I are tight. He knows I have poor eyesight, so He’s fixed it so when I get up in the middle of the night to go to the bathroom, poof! The light goes on. When I’m done, poof! The light goes off.”
“Wow, that’s incredible,” the doctor says.
A little later in the day, the doctor calls Larry’s wife.
“Bonnie,” he says, “Larry is doing fine! But I had to call you because I’m in awe of his relationship with God. Is it true that he gets up during the night, and poof, the light goes on in the bathroom, and when he’s done, poof, the light goes off?”
“Oh sweet Jesus”, exclaims Bonnie. “He’s peeing in the refrigerator again!”
gist: An old man believes God turns the bathroom light on for him at night, and his wife reveals he has been peeing into the refrigerator.

text:
My friend said to me, “Do you want to hear a really good Batman impression!?” I said, “Go on, then.” He shouted, “NOT THE KRYPTONITE!” I said, “That’s Superman.”
He said, “Thanks man, I’ve been practicing a lot.”
gist: A friend does a 'Batman impression' with a Superman line, and when corrected 'That's Superman' he hears it as praise and thanks his friend.

text:
My neighbour knocked on my door at 2:30am this morning, can you believe that, 2:30am?!
Luckily for him I was still up playing my Bagpipes
gist: A man complains about his neighbor knocking at 2:30 a.m., then admits he was luckily still up playing the bagpipes, the obvious reason for the visit.

text:
A group of Engineering professors were invited to fly in a plane.
Right after they were comfortably seated, they were informed the plane was built by their students.
All but one got off their seats and headed frantically to the exits in maniacal panic.
The one lone professor that stayed put, calmly in his seat, was asked: “Why did you stay put?”
“I have plenty of confidence in my students. Knowing them, I for a fact can assure you this piece of shit plane will never even start”
gist: Engineering professors flee a plane built by their students, except one who stays calm because he knows his students' plane will never even start.

text:
A woman goes into a restaurant with 15 kids.
The kids start goofing around while she's talking to the waitress. The mom gets impatient and yells, "Eddy! Stop that! Or else!" All 15 boys suddenly sit down, obedient and quiet.
The waitress asks, **"Did you really name all 15 of your boys Eddy?"**
"Yup," says the woman. "Makes it easier than trying to remember who's who every damn time."
"But what if you only want to talk to one of them for some reason?" the waitress asks.
**"Well, then I just call them by their last names."**
gist: A mother named all 15 sons the same so one shout controls them all, and to address just one she uses their last names, implying different fathers.

text:
Wife texts husband on a cold winter morning: "Windows frozen, won't open."
Husband texts back: "Gently pour some lukewarm water over it and then gently tap edges with hammer."
Wife texts back 10 minutes later: "Computer really messed up now."
gist: A wife texts that the windows are frozen, the husband advises warm water and tapping with a hammer, and she reports the computer is now ruined since she meant the operating system.

text:
A taxi driver, new on the job, picks up his first customer.
The driver then started to head to the location designated by the passenger. A few minutes had passed and the whole trip had been quiet ever since. The radio wasn't even turned on.
The passenger is very interpersonal so he started to strike a conversation to break the silence.
"Hey, ma-"
"HOLY FUCKING SHIT!!!!!"  The driver abruptly hit the breaks.
"Dude, wtf!" the passenger complained. The driver then apologised "Sorry, man. It's my first time on the job and I haven't adjusted from my previous job yet."
"What did you do before this?"
"I drove a hearse."
gist: A new taxi driver panics and slams the brakes when his passenger speaks, explaining he used to drive a hearse where passengers never talk.

text:
This German shepherd comes and takes a shit on my lawn every day.
Yesterday, he brought his dog along.
gist: A 'German shepherd' who fouls the narrator's lawn daily turns out to be a German man, revealed when he brings his dog along.

text:
Doctor: Do you want the good news first, or the bad news?
Man: Good news first please, doc!
Doctor: We’re naming a disease after you
gist: A doctor's 'good news' for the patient is that a disease will be named after him, revealing a terrible new diagnosis.

text:
When you pull the pin on a grenade, how do you put it back in?
Quick answers please.
gist: Someone who already pulled a grenade pin asks how to put it back and urgently requests quick answers.

text:
“Doc, I ate one of those ‘Do not Eat’ silica packets. Am I going to die??”
Doctor: Well, everyone is going to die eventually.
Man: Everyone?? Holy shit,  what have I done?
gist: A patient who ate a silica packet hears 'everyone will die eventually' and panics that he has doomed everyone.

text:
Interviewer: How do you explain this 4 year gap on your resume?
Me: That’s when I went to Yale.
Interviewer: That’s impressive. You are hired.
Me: Thanks. I really need this Yob.
gist: A job candidate explains a four-year gap as Yale and gets hired, then says 'Yob', revealing he pronounces J as Y and meant jail.

text:
I was at a job interview today when the manager handed me his laptop and said
"I want you to try to sell this to me."
So I put it under my arm, walked out of the building, and went home.
Eventually he called me and said "Bring my laptop back here right now!"
I said "$200 and it's yours."
gist: Asked at an interview to sell the manager his laptop, the candidate walks off with it and sells it back to him by phone.

text:
After 10 years, the wife starts to think their kid looks kind of strange. So she decides to do a DNA test. She finds out that the kid is actually from completely different parents.
Wife: "Honey, I have something very serious to tell you."
Husband: "What’s up?"
Wife: "According to the DNA test results, this is not our kid."
Husband: "Well you don’t remember, do you?? When we were leaving the hospital, we noticed that our baby had pooped. You said: Please go change the baby, I’ll wait for you here."
gist: A DNA test shows the couple's child is not theirs, and the husband admits he swapped babies at the hospital to avoid changing a diaper.

text:
My tongue slipped when I was asking my wife to "pass the milk, honey" when we had breakfast yesterday
I accidentally said: "Fuck you Helen you ruined my fucking life"
gist: A husband calls his breakfast outburst of pent-up hatred at his wife a mere slip of the tongue.

text:
I saw two kids fighting on the elementary school playground and being the only adult around, I had to step in...
Little bastards didn’t stand a chance…
gist: As the only adult near two kids fighting on a playground, the narrator 'steps in' and beats them both up.

text:
Some asshole knocked on my door today, telling me I needed to be “saved” or else I would “burn”. I told him to fuck off.
Stupid fireman.
gist: A man rudely dismisses a visitor warning he must be saved or he'll burn, taking him for a preacher, but it was a fireman.

text:
I got pulled over by the police ...
He came to the window and said papers ...
I said - scissors, I win - and drove off
He must be desperate for a rematch as he's been chasing me for ages!
gist: A cop asks for 'papers', the driver answers 'scissors, I win' as in rock-paper-scissors and drives off, reading the chase as a demand for a rematch.

text:
My best friend passed away recently, and grieving before his grave I said,
"Bro, I really miss you. My wife has been pregnant for 8 months now. How about you reincarnate as my child?"
A month later, my wife gave birth to a big boy. As my child grew older each day, I realized he looks a lot like my best friend.
I'm really happy that my prayer worked.
gist: A man asks his dead best friend to reincarnate as his unborn son, and takes the boy's resemblance to the friend as proof the prayer worked, missing the affair.

text:
Jack wakes up with a horrible hangover and a throbbing black eye.
The first thing he sees is a single rose on the side table and a note from his wife: “Dear, breakfast is made. I’ve gone shopping to make you your favorite dinner tonight. I love you!”
He stumbles to the kitchen and, sure enough, there’s breakfast. “Joe,” he says to his son, “what happened last night?”
“You came home soused and got that black eye tripping over a chair.”
“So, why the rose, breakfast, and sweet note from your mother?”
“Oh, that. Mom dragged you to the bedroom, and when she tried to take off your clothes, you screamed, ‘Leave me alone, I’m married!’”
gist: A hungover husband finds a loving note and breakfast from his wife, and his son explains that drunk, he fought off her undressing him shouting he was married.

text:
I was browsing in a liquor store when an employee asked me “Do you need help?”
I said, “Yes, but I’m here to get whiskey instead.”
gist: A liquor store clerk asks if he needs help and he says yes, but he's here for whiskey instead, taking help as psychological help.

text:
Two boys are arguing when the teacher enters the classroom. The teacher says, “What are you two arguing about?”
One boy answers, “We found a ten-dollar bill and decided whoever tells the biggest lie gets to keep it.”
“You two should be ashamed of yourselves,” said the teacher. “When I was your age, I didn’t even know what a lie was.”
The boys looked at each other and handed the ten dollars to the teacher.
gist: Boys hold a lying contest for found money; the teacher scolds them, claiming she never knew what a lie was at their age, and they hand her the prize for the biggest lie.

text:
I asked my mom if by any chance i was adopted ?
She said - why would we choose you..
gist: Child asks mother if they were adopted and she replies that nobody would have chosen them, insulting the child.

text:
Went to donate blood today...awful experience, never again....
Question after question..."who's blood is it?"....."where did you get it?"....."why is it in a bucket?
gist: Speaker complains blood donation staff asked too many questions, which reveal he brought someone else's blood in a bucket.

text:
My wife laughed when I said I still had the body of an 18 year old.
Until she checked the freezer.
gist: Wife laughs when husband claims he still has the body of an 18-year-old, until she finds an actual body in the freezer.

text:
A woman and her lover were in bed, when the woman heard her husband getting back.
The woman said “Quick! Rub baby powder on you and pretend to be a statue.” The lover did that.
The husband walked into the room.
“Honey, what’s this statue doing here?” He asked.
“I saw that the Smiths got one, so I decided to get one as well.” She replied.
The husband got into bed, and the woman fell asleep. A few hours later, after checking his wife was asleep, he quietly got up, walked into  kitchen, made a sandwich and got a glass of milk, came back, and went to the statue.
“Here, have something to eat and drink. I stood like an idiot for 3 days at the Smiths, and no one offered me anything to eat!”
gist: Wife disguises her lover as a statue; at night the husband brings the statue food, saying nobody fed him when he stood as a statue at the neighbors'.
